author: National Geographic
description:
How did Genghis Khan rise to power? In this second full episode of Genghis Khan: The Secret History of the Mongols from National Geographic, witness the rise of one of the most famous ancient rulers. Before he was an emperor, he was an outcast. Temujin survived betrayal, defeat, and a decade in exile to become Genghis Khan, also known as Chinggis Khan. When an alliance with his close friend Jamuqa turns into a brutal rivalry, Temujin suffers a crushing defeat and is forced to spend 10 years in exile with the Jin Empire. Upon his return, he reasserts control over the Mongolian plains, subjugates all who oppose him, and takes the title by which he will forever be known: Genghis Khan.
